description: This file defines an Angular component named AppShellComponent, which serves as the main layout shell for the application. It includes navigation bars, side navigation, footer, and a router outlet for rendering routed content. The component interacts with NgRx store to manage UI state such as dark mode and sidebar collapse.

classes.name: AppShellComponent
classes.description: Main application layout shell including navigation, theme toggling, and routing outlet. Uses Angular, NgRx store for state management, and various Angular common modules.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Dispatches an action to toggle between light and dark themes.

methods.name: toggleSidebar
methods.description: Dispatches an action to toggle the sidebar's collapsed or expanded state.
